create_image_segmentation_pipeline: create an image segmentation pipeline that detects object masks and their classes from images
run_image_segmentation_single_image: run the image segmentation pipeline on a single image URL or local path to return labeled masks
run_image_segmentation_batch: run the image segmentation pipeline on a batch of images to return per-image lists of detected segments
configure_segmentation_subtask: configure the segmentation pipeline subtask to use panoptic, instance, or semantic segmentation mode
postprocess_segmentation_outputs: postprocess model outputs into annotated masks with labels, scores, and binary mask images
